title: Tab Teacher
blurb: A practice app for learning guitar solos.
long: A practice app for learning guitar solos. Pick a song from the menu and work through the solo with the tab in front of you. Built because I wanted it for my own practicing.

title: The Paw
blurb: The website for Denver Jewish Day School's student newspaper, with a CMS so editors can publish without code.
long: The website for Denver Jewish Day School's student newspaper, which I created. Readers get a fast static site with sections, an archive with search, staff pages and an RSS feed. Editors get a CMS (Keystatic) so they can publish without touching code.

title: Daily Tracker
blurb: A native desktop habit tracker with streaks, heatmaps and phone reminders.

title: The Forge
blurb: AP Lang essay practice with AI-generated prompts, AI grading, XP, badges and a global leaderboard.

title: Spherical Voronoi
blurb: Interactive Voronoi diagrams on the surface of a sphere.
long: Voronoi diagrams, but on the surface of a sphere instead of a flat plane. Seed points split the globe into cells, each one holding everything closer to its seed than to any other.

title: Final Grade Calculator
blurb: Work out exactly what you need on your final to hit the grade you want.

title: 3D Projection
blurb: Projecting 3D vertices onto a 2D screen from scratch, plus a tutorial on the math.

title: Desmos SAT Prep
blurb: An interactive guide to solving SAT math problems with the Desmos calculator, with 100+ practice questions.

title: ReelTab
blurb: Native macOS app that turns guitar tab scrolling past in Reels/TikToks into an editable, playable tab.

title: Arduino Parkour
blurb: A wall-dodging game on a 16×2 LCD with a joystick. You can play a simulation of it in the browser.

title: Training Log
blurb: A mobile-first workout tracker that imports custom training programs.

title: Lloyd Relaxation
blurb: Lloyd-Max Voronoi relaxation: watch points spread themselves out evenly, live in the browser.
